									function size_and_position_player_container(){
										var ww = $(window).width();
										var wh = $(window).height();

										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										video_container.css('left', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_width = video_container.width();
										var video_container_height = video_container.height();
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_container_left = video_container_offset.left;
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('left', '-'+video_container_left + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('width', ww + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('height', wh + 'px');

									function position_player_container(){

										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
									}

									$( window ).on( "scroll", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											position_player_container();
										}
									});

									$( window ).on( "resize", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											size_and_position_player_container();
										}
									});

									width: 640,
									height: 480,
									};
									var big_menu_vrs_video_player = new Vimeo.Player('big-menu__captioncall__feature__video', options);

									var play_button = $('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__play-button');
									var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
									play_button.on('click', function(){
										video_container.addClass('playing');
										$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').addClass('playing');
										size_and_position_player_container();
										big_menu_vrs_video_player.play();

										$('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__close, .big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__overlay').on('click', function(e){
											$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').removeClass('playing');
											video_container.removeClass('playing');
											big_menu_vrs_video_player.pause();
										});
									});

									var video_json_url = 'https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=https://vimeo.com/1004217163/bc441f1385?share=copy';
									$.getJSON(video_json_url, function(data){
										let url = data.thumbnail_url;
										let image_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__image');
										image_container.css('background-image', 'url(' + url + ')');		
										let title = data.title;
										$('.big-menu__feature__title--captioncall a').text(title);								
									});


									function size_and_position_player_container(){
										var ww = $(window).width();
										var wh = $(window).height();
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										video_container.css('left', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_width = video_container.width();
										var video_container_height = video_container.height();
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_container_left = video_container_offset.left;
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('left', '-'+video_container_left + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('width', ww + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('height', wh + 'px');
									}

									function position_player_container(){
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
									}

									$( window ).on( "scroll", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											position_player_container();
										}
									});

									$( window ).on( "resize", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											size_and_position_player_container();
										}
									});

								})(jQuery);

							</script>

									width: 640,
									height: 480,
									};
									var big_menu_vrs_video_player = new Vimeo.Player('big-menu__captioncall__feature__video', options);

									var play_button = $('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__play-button');
									var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
									play_button.on('click', function(){
										video_container.addClass('playing');
										$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').addClass('playing');
										size_and_position_player_container();
										big_menu_vrs_video_player.play();

										$('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__close, .big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__overlay').on('click', function(e){
											$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').removeClass('playing');
											video_container.removeClass('playing');
											big_menu_vrs_video_player.pause();
										});
									});

									var video_json_url = 'https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=https://vimeo.com/1004217163/bc441f1385?share=copy';
									$.getJSON(video_json_url, function(data){
										let url = data.thumbnail_url;
										let image_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__image');
										image_container.css('background-image', 'url(' + url + ')');		
										let title = data.title;
										$('.big-menu__feature__title--captioncall a').text(title);								
									});


									function size_and_position_player_container(){
										var ww = $(window).width();
										var wh = $(window).height();
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										video_container.css('left', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_width = video_container.width();
										var video_container_height = video_container.height();
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_container_left = video_container_offset.left;
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('left', '-'+video_container_left + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('width', ww + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('height', wh + 'px');
									}

									function position_player_container(){
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
									}

									$( window ).on( "scroll", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											position_player_container();
										}
									});

									$( window ).on( "resize", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											size_and_position_player_container();
										}
									});

								})(jQuery);

							</script>

</h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-06ab1460"><p data-renderer-start-pos="9750">CaptionCall is part of the federal government’s <a class="cc-1rn59kg" title="https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/internet-protocol-ip-captioned-telephone-service" href="https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/internet-protocol-ip-captioned-telephone-service" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-testid="link-with-safety" data-renderer-mark="true">Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (IP CTS) program</a>, part of a mandate of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) to ensure people with hearing loss have equal access to telephone calls.  </p><p data-renderer-start-pos="10029">The funding for the service comes from fees the <span data-highlighted="true"><span class="_11q7y4f7 _5pioz8co _189eyh40 _n3tdv77o _1il9nqa1 _19lc184f _d0altlke acronym-highlight" data-testid="acronym-highlight">FCC</span></span> collects from telecommunications companies. The <span data-highlighted="true">FCC</span> uses that funding to reimburse each minute of caption call service Sorenson provides instead of customers paying for it out of pocket. This is why the service is only available to people with hearing loss who need captions to use the phone. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-65bfbdaa" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-65bfbdaa"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-65bfbdaa" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>Do I need hearing loss to use CaptionCall or CaptionCall Mobile? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-65bfbdaa"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 ["table",{"displayMode":null,"isNumberColumnEnabled":false,"layout":"default","localId":"b3195532-211d-4e7f-a33b-9c9d340de5a5","width":1166,"__autoSize":false},"tableRow",null,"tableCell",{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[140],"background":null}]">Yes. Only people with hearing loss who need captions to use the phone effectively may use CaptionCall and CaptionCall Mobile. This isn’t just our policy; it’s the law. The Federal TRS fund supports Sorenson’s call captioning services and only permits deaf and hard-of-hearing users to register for service. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-5ce09b85" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-5ce09b85"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-5ce09b85" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i> What does IP CTS stand for?</h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-5ce09b85"><p data-renderer-start-pos="10867">Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (<span data-highlighted="true">IP</span> CTS) is a form of telecommunications relay service (<span data-highlighted="true">TRS</span>) that enables an individual who can speak, but who has difficulty hearing, to use a phone. They can simultaneously listen to the other person and read captions of what the other person is saying. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-1fbdf4c9" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-1fbdf4c9"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-1fbdf4c9" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>Why do I need to give personal information to sign up? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-1fbdf4c9"><p>As part of the <span data-highlighted="true">FCC</span> requirements of the <span data-highlighted="true">IP</span> CTS program, Sorenson must validate our users are actual people and not fictional or fraudulent sign-ups. This is the reason we ask for your registration information. </p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-toggle-container-panel" id="homephone" data-model-id="f0b2d59f" data-vce-content=".vce-toggle-container-panel-body"><div class="vce-toggle-container-tab-inner"><div class="vce-toggle-container-panel-heading"><a class="vce-toggle-container-panel-title" href="#homephone" data-vce-target="[data-model-id=f0b2d59f]" data-vce-use-cache="false" data-vce-toggle-container-accordion="" data-vce-container=".vce-toggle-container-inner" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="homephone" id="accordion-f0b2d59f">Home phone </a></div><div class="vce-toggle-container-panel-body" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-f0b2d59f accordion-f0b2d59f" data-vce-do-apply="all el-f0b2d59f" hidden="hidden"><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-32040562" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-32040562"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-32040562" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>What are the qualifications to receive a CaptionCall home phone? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-32040562"><p>Anyone who qualifies for CaptionCall service can receive a CaptionCall phone to access their call captioning. <p data-renderer-start-pos="16760">If the incoming calls are going to your built-in phone app rather than the CaptionCall Mobile app, you need to set up Call Forwarding to CaptionCall Mobile. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-a5569b14" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-a5569b14"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-a5569b14" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i> Why does the app show a different phone number than mine?</h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-a5569b14"><p data-renderer-start-pos="16453">When you register for a CaptionCall mobile account, you get a unique CaptionCall Mobile phone number for captioned calls. However, you can continue using your usual phone number – for incoming and outgoing calls – by setting up Call Forwarding and My Caller ID. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-b7f4678f" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-b7f4678f"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-b7f4678f" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>How do I set up My Caller ID?</h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-b7f4678f"><p data-renderer-start-pos="17353">Using My Caller ID will display your usual phone number when you make outgoing calls, so your friends and family know it’s you calling. </p><p data-renderer-start-pos="17519">To set it up: </p><ol><li data-renderer-start-pos="17537">Open the CaptionCall Mobile menu options by tapping on the menu icon </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="17610">Tap My Caller ID </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="17631">Tap I agree </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="17647">Tap Add Feature! </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="17668">Tap Done </li></ol></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-100428da" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-100428da"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-100428da" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i> Can I change my CaptionCall Mobile number to a specific number? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-100428da"><p data-renderer-start-pos="17772">When you register for your CaptionCall Mobile account, we automatically assign a CaptionCall Mobile number with your specified area code, and we cannot change it to a specific number. </p>
<p data-renderer-start-pos="17986">However, you can set up Call Forwarding and My Caller ID to keep using your regular phone number for all calls. </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-ac1d5353" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-ac1d5353"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-ac1d5353" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i> How do I record my own voicemail greeting? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-ac1d5353"><p data-renderer-start-pos="18170">You can change your CaptionCall Mobile outgoing voicemail message from the voicemail menu. </p><p data-renderer-start-pos="18291">To record a personal voicemail greeting: </p><ol><li data-renderer-start-pos="18336">Press and hold the 1 on the CaptionCall Mobile dialer (or dial *97) </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="18408">Press * to reach the voicemail menu </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="18448">Press 4 to record your personal mailbox greeting </li></ol><p data-renderer-start-pos="18501">To reset your voicemail greeting: </p><ol><li data-renderer-start-pos="18539">Press and hold the 1 on the CaptionCall Mobile dialer (or dial *97) </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="18611">Press * to reach the voicemail menu </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="18651">Press 9 to select a default mailbox greeting </li></ol></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-a5bb68ad" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-a5bb68ad"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-a5bb68ad" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>How do I connect my Bluetooth device to CaptionCall Mobile? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-a5bb68ad"><p data-renderer-start-pos="18787">When your Bluetooth device is connected to your phone, the CaptionCall Mobile app will automatically detect it. </p>
<p data-renderer-start-pos="18929">During a call, the Bluetooth icon should appear in the call menu when a Bluetooth device is connected to your phone. Just tap the icon to toggle between speakerphone, handset, or Bluetooth mode. </p>
<p data-renderer-start-pos="19126"><em data-renderer-mark="true">Tip: If you don’t see the Bluetooth icon, check your phone settings to make sure Bluetooth is enabled and connected to your Bluetooth device.</em> </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-2eadd89d" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-2eadd89d"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-2eadd89d" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>How do I delete my call history? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-2eadd89d"><p data-renderer-start-pos="19330">Saving call captions doesn’t take up much space, but it can add up. You may find that you want to delete some of the saved conversations from your device. </p><p data-renderer-start-pos="19515">You can delete your call history in the History tab of the CaptionCall Mobile app. Here’s how: </p><ul><li data-renderer-start-pos="19614">Tap <strong data-renderer-mark="true">Edit </strong>at the top right of the screen. </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="19614">Select the calls you wish to delete or tap <strong data-renderer-mark="true">Select All </strong>at the top right. </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="19759">Once you have the calls selected, tap <strong data-renderer-mark="true">Delete</strong> at the bottom of the screen. The calls will then be deleted from your call history. </li><li data-renderer-start-pos="19904">To cancel the operation, tap <strong data-renderer-mark="true">Cancel</strong> at the top of the screen. </li></ul><p data-renderer-start-pos="19970"> </p></div></div></div></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle vce-faq-toggle-color--b-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape-color--ba-0-0-0-0 vce-faq-toggle-shape--rounded"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-wrapper vce" id="el-6b051181" data-vce-do-apply="margin padding border background  el-6b051181"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-inner"><div class="vce-faq-toggle-title"><h5 class="vce-faq-toggle-title-text" aria-controls="faqToggle-6b051181" aria-expanded="false"><i class="vce-faq-toggle-icon"></i>How do I increase the font size of the call captions? </h5></div><div class="vce-faq-toggle-text-block" role="region" id="faqToggle-b9a8fb86"><p data-renderer-start-pos="20643">By default, CaptionCall Mobile captions both sides of the conversation. Hearing point-to-point video users will not be able to place emergency calls.   const FIELD_ID = "input_115_12";

  function getReferralCode() {
    const cookie = document.cookie
      .split(";")
      .map(c => c.trim())
      .find(c => c.startsWith(COOKIE_NAME + "="));

    if (!cookie) return "";

    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(
        cookie.substring(COOKIE_NAME.length + 1)
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return "";
    }
  }

  function populateReferralCode() {
    const field = document.getElementById(FIELD_ID);
    const code = getReferralCode();

    if (!field || !code) return;

    // Don't overwrite a code manually entered.
    if (field.value.trim() !== "") return;

    field.value = code;

    field.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("input", { bubbles: true })
    );

    field.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("change", { bubbles: true })
    );
  }

  // Initial page load
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      populateReferralCode
    );

							<script>
								(function($){
									var options = {
									url: 'https://vimeo.com/1004217163/bc441f1385?share=copy',
									width: 640,
									height: 480,
									};
									var big_menu_vrs_video_player = new Vimeo.Player('big-menu__captioncall__feature__video', options);

									var play_button = $('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__play-button');
									var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
									play_button.on('click', function(){
										video_container.addClass('playing');
										$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').addClass('playing');
										size_and_position_player_container();
										big_menu_vrs_video_player.play();

										$('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__close, .big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container__overlay').on('click', function(e){
											$('#big-menu__captioncall__feature__video').removeClass('playing');
											video_container.removeClass('playing');
											big_menu_vrs_video_player.pause();
										});
									});

									var video_json_url = 'https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=https://vimeo.com/1004217163/bc441f1385?share=copy';
									$.getJSON(video_json_url, function(data){
										let url = data.thumbnail_url;
										let image_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__feature__video__image');
										image_container.css('background-image', 'url(' + url + ')');		
										let title = data.title;
										$('.big-menu__feature__title--captioncall a').text(title);								
									});


									function size_and_position_player_container(){
										var ww = $(window).width();
										var wh = $(window).height();
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										video_container.css('left', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_width = video_container.width();
										var video_container_height = video_container.height();
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_container_left = video_container_offset.left;
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('left', '-'+video_container_left + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('width', ww + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('height', wh + 'px');
									}

									function position_player_container(){
										var video_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
									}

									$( window ).on( "scroll", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											position_player_container();
										}
									});

									$( window ).on( "resize", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											size_and_position_player_container();
										}
									});

								})(jQuery);

							</script>

									function size_and_position_player_container(){
										var ww = $(window).width();
										var wh = $(window).height();

										video_container.css('top', 0 + 'px');
										video_container.css('left', 0 + 'px');
										var video_container_width = video_container.width();
										var video_container_height = video_container.height();
										var video_container_offset = video_container.offset();
										var video_container_top = video_container_offset.top;
										var video_container_left = video_container_offset.left;
										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										var video_players_container = $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container');
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('left', '-'+video_container_left + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('width', ww + 'px');
										video_players_container.css('height', wh + 'px');

									function position_player_container(){

										var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
										var top = scrollTop - video_container_top;
										video_players_container.css('top', top + 'px');
									}

									$( window ).on( "scroll", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											position_player_container();
										}
									});

									$( window ).on( "resize", function() {
										if( $('.big-menu__captioncall__video-player-container').hasClass('playing') ){
											size_and_position_player_container();
										}
									});
